benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status, including a 25% points bonus on paid stays, late checkout, a welcome gift via points, and room upgrades when available.
benefits.terms: Automatic upon card approval; requires a linked Marriott Bonvoy account.

benefits.name: Annual Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: 15 Elite Night Credits toward the next level of Marriott Bonvoy Elite status.
benefits.terms: Credited automatically each calendar year toward elite status qualification.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: One Free Night Award every year after the card renewal month (redemption level at or under 35,000 Marriott Bonvoy points), plus an additional Free Night Award after spending $60,000 on the card in a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Base award issued automatically after card renewal month. The additional award requires $60,000 in calendar-year card spend. Resort fees may apply.

benefits.name: Amex Business Card Member Rate
benefits.description: Automatic discount off standard room rates at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels when booking the Amex Biz Card Member Rate.
benefits.terms: Approximately 7% off standard rates; must book via the designated Amex Biz Card Member Rate on Marriott's site.

benefits.name: Premium In-Room Internet
benefits.description: Complimentary premium in-room internet access at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss & Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft of most rental vehicles.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen checked and carry-on baggage on a covered trip.

benefits.name: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 emergency coordination and assistance when traveling more than 100 miles from home.
benefits.terms: Assistance services only; cardholder is responsible for the cost of any services rendered.

earningRates.terms: Eligible purchases at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy.
Restaurants worldwide, U.S. gas stations, wireless telephone services purchased directly from U.S. service providers, and U.S. purchases for shipping.
